arguments: $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $install='C:\Program Files\Infinix AI NAS'; $versionFile=Join-Path $install 'VERSION.txt'; $services=@(Get-Service | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'Infinix|NAS' -or $_.DisplayName -match 'Infinix|NAS' } | Select-Object Name,DisplayName,Status,StartType); $processes=@(Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match 'infinix|nas' } | Select-Object ProcessName,Id,SessionId,Path); $sessionUser=(Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem).UserName; $data=[ordered]@{hostname=$env:COMPUTERNAME;whoami=(& whoami);interactive_user=$sessionUser;temp=[IO.Path]::GetTempPath();install_path=$install;install_exists=(Test-Path -LiteralPath $install);version_exists=(Test-Path -LiteralPath $versionFile);version_text=(if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $versionFile){(Get-Content -LiteralPath $versionFile -Raw)}else{$null});services=$services;processes=$processes;logs_exists=(Test-Path -LiteralPath 'C:\InfinixNAS\logs')}; $data | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress
